build_edgenext_backbone: build an EdgeNeXt backbone model with xxsmall architecture for mobile vision applications
create_sdta_encoder: create an SDTAEncoder with split depth-wise transpose attention and channel self-attention
build_convnext_stage: build ConvNeXt blocks as stage components within the EdgeNeXt backbone stages
freeze_edgenext_stages: freeze specified stages of the EdgeNeXt backbone to prevent gradient updates
extract_stage_features: extract feature maps from specified output indices of the EdgeNeXt backbone
